  • Method Details

    • userAgent

      RuntimeEmulationActionsContract userAgent(String userAgent)
      Overrides the user agent for the current BiDi browsing context. Playwright contexts use playwright.userAgent before session creation.

    • clearUserAgent

      RuntimeEmulationActionsContract clearUserAgent()
      Clears the user-agent override.

    • disableScripting

      RuntimeEmulationActionsContract disableScripting()
      Disables scripting for the current BiDi browsing context. WebDriver BiDi does not provide a symmetric force-enable override; call clearScriptingOverride() to restore the context default. Playwright contexts use playwright.javaScriptEnabled before session creation.

    • clearScriptingOverride

      RuntimeEmulationActionsContract clearScriptingOverride()
